strategy_roster.name: Heikin Ashi V2
strategy_roster.notes: Heikin-Ashi values are unsupported, so a bullish regular candle above EMA(20) proxies HA_Close > HA_Open and close > EMA; the bearish counterpart exits.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Zig-Zag LuxAlgo
strategy_roster.notes: Zig-Zag and Bounce Speed are unsupported; ROC(3) turning positive within five bars of a prior 20-bar Donchian-low touch proxies the long reversal. Numeric lengths are explicit translation choices because the corpus gives none.

strategy_roster.name: Gemini Trend Following System
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,sma(close,50)) and sma(close,50) > sma(close,200) and roc(close,252) > 15
strategy_roster.notes: The recovery cross above SMA(50), SMA(50) above SMA(200), and 252-day ROC above 15% retain the documented long filter. No catastrophic-stop percentage is supplied.

strategy_roster.name: Sunil 2 Bar Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Exact lagged-bar comparisons are unavailable; an up close plus a new three-bar high proxies the two-bar bullish setup, while a prior three-bar-low break approximates the signal-bar stop.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Arbitrage Spread Oscillator Model (VASOM)
strategy_roster.notes: The VIX front/second-contract spread and second security are unavailable, so single-stock close RSI(2) preserves the documented 46/76 thresholds.

strategy_roster.name: Breakthrough BB
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(9) filter and Bollinger(28,1.6) breakout are retained. SMA trend loss is an exit proxy because the corpus gives no explicit exit rule.

strategy_roster.name: Exp KWAN NRP
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic and the undocumented KWAN ratio are unsupported; SMA(3)-smoothed RSI(14) and ROC(14) proxy a bullish ratio turn and bearish reversal. Price-step SL/TP are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: FT CCI MA (StockSharp port)
strategy_roster.entry_long: (close > sma((high + low + 2 * close) / 4,200) and zscore((high + low + close) / 3,14) < -1.67) or zscore((high + low + close) / 3,14) < -2.67
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and LWMA are unavailable; SMA of the documented weighted price and z-score of typical price approximate them, with -1.67/-2.67 proxying the -100/-200 long thresholds. The 150-pip SL/TP are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: SuperForexV2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented RSI(4) crossings are exact: below 42 enters long and above 62 exits it. Pip-based TP, SL, and trail are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: 4153 Vortex Oscillator System
strategy_roster.notes: Vortex is unavailable and oscillator threshold defaults are omitted; ROC(14) zero crossings proxy a long momentum escape and return to neutral. Oscillator SL/TP levels are unsupported.
